raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (business date 2026-01-17) was ingested twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00. It holds 698 rows, which is 349 keys × 2. The copies are identical in every column except ingest_ts, so silver_transactions double-counts 327 POSTED transactions and inflates every gold aggregate for 2026-01-17. The fix is to deduplicate raw_transactions on txn_id, keeping one copy, before the status filter in silver_transactions; the gold steps then recompute correctly unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
